List of selected candidates for staff nurse post
Monday, 27 July 2020
6590 Hits
We had published an advertisement for Post of staff nurses (vide order no. 1675,  07.01.2020).  Total post 30 were advertised (ST-4, SEBC-6, VJNT-5, EWS-5 OPEN-10). The last date of application submission was on 31
st
January, 2020. Of the 530 applications received, and called for written test, 470 Candidate appeared for written test on 04.03.2020.
The Scrutiny committee has shortlisted 29 candidates (as per the category) on the basis of class 12
th
and GNM exam marks, written test marks and work experience. Selected candidate have been asked to visit M.S. Office for verification of documents and joining procedure.
